The lecture's results come from 750 real runs. Pick a task and a prompt to see what each model did, then click a square to read that run.

::: {.callout-note}
These runs used an earlier version of the practice script and data, with only `x`. The exception is the IQR task, whose runs used today's `y ~ x + z`. The other runs will be redone on today's script.
:::

```{=html}
<div id="explorer" class="column-page">
  <div class="rx-controls">

    <div class="rx-row">

    </div>
    <div class="rx-row">
```
